name: the language
headline: The *language* of Hypercomb
say: Hypercomb has its own language, and each word is exact. A hive is your own place, kept on your machine, that you open to your people. A tile is one piece of content. A layer is one moment of a place, kept for good. A signature is the name the content gives itself. A bee, short for beehavior, acts when it is needed, or when you say its word. A pheromone is a signed signal of interest someone leaves on content, so people whose own interests match can find it; carrying it to them is still being built. Replication is how work crosses between hives, checked byte by byte. The brood is where code from someone else waits, held and never run, until your own hand accepts it. And a colony is a domain with the hives it hosts; there are many, and none of them is in charge.
